CITY OF LA VERNE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, November 10, 2021

1.  Chairperson Simison called the regular meeting of the La Verne Planning
  Commission to order at 6:30 p.m.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Commissioner Simison led the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  ROLL CALL: Planning Commissioners present: Thomas Allison, Jeffry Allred,
  Jason Lorge, Jeremy Conrad, and Jason Simison. Advisory personnel present:
  Community Development Director Eric Scherer, City Attorney Bob Kress,
  Assistant Planner Gabriel Rivera, Principal Planner Candice Bowcock and
  Secretary Natalie Hiatt.

4.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  None

PUBLIC HEARINGS

5.  CASE NO. 87-21CUP; A REQUEST TO OBTAIN A CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT TO MAINTAIN HORSES, GOATS, AND CHICKENS AT 4788
  ARGO CIRCLE.

  RESOLUTION NO. 1282

  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, STATE OF CALIFORNIA,
  APPROVING CASE NO. 87-21CUP ALLOWING THE KEEPING AND
  MAINTAINING OF TWO HORSES, TWO GOATS, AND TEN
  CHICKENS AT 4788 ARGO CIRCLE, LA VERNE, AND AFFIRMING A
  CATEGORICAL EXPEMPTION FOR THE PROJECT.

  Mr. Scherer stated that one additional comment was received via email and an
  update was made to the resolution with minor changes to the verbiage.

  Assistant Planner Gabriel Rivera presented his staff report.

  The applicant Michelle Lucarelli-Beltran was present at the meeting.
 Planning Commission Minutes
November 10, 2021
  Chairperson Simison opened the public hearing.

  There were 10 public comments received via email or letters.

  The following residents spoke in support of the conditional use permit:
  Sharon V.
  Bob Rode
  Ray Cervantes
  Jaclyn Bradle

  Chairperson Simison closed the public hearing.

  The Commissioners discussed the existing barn, number of chickens allowed, and
  expiration date of the conditional use permit.

  Commissioner Allred requested specific language be added to identify the
  number of chickens allowed.

  Chairperson Simison suggested extending the permit to 20 years to lessen the
  burden.

  It was moved by Commissioner Allred and seconded by Commissioner Lorge to
  amend Item No. 11 to limit the number of chickens to 10 and prohibit roosters.
  Motion carried by a 4-1 vote (Commissioner Conrad opposed).

  It was moved by Chairperson Simison and seconded by Commissioner Lorge to
  amend Item Nos. 26 & 27. Increasing the term from 10 to 20 years and adding the
  verbiage “significant number of complaints”. Motion carried by a 5-0 vote.

  It was moved by Commissioner Conrad and seconded by Commissioner Lorge to
  approve Case No. 87-21CUP with the revisions to Resolution No. 1282. Motion
  carried by a 5-0 vote.

OTHER MATTERS

6.  ACTIVE TRANSPORTATION PLAN

  THE DRAFT ACTIVE TRANSPORTATION PLAN ESTABLISHES THE
  CITY’S VISION AND COMPREHENSIVE APPROACH TO IMPROVING
  WALKING, BIKING, AND ROLLING IN LA VERNE. THE PLAN
  STRIVES TO IMPROVE FACILITIES, SUCH AS SIDEWALKS AND
  BIKE LANES TO ENHANCE ACCESS TO AND EXPERIENCES OF
  ACTIVE TRANSPORTATION AND PROVIDE MORE OPPORTUNITIES
  FOR LOCAL, RECREATIONAL MOVEMENT, INCLUSIVE OF ANY
  AGE OR ABILITY. THE PLANNING COMMISSION SERVES A KEY
  ROLE IN RECEIVING PUBLIC INPUT ON THE SUBJECT AND IN

  2
 Planning Commission Minutes
November 10, 2021
  HELPING TO SHAPE CITY POLICIES ON ACTIVE
  TRANSPORTATION.

  Ms. Bowcock presented her staff report.

  Chairperson Simison opened public comment. There were no comments.

  Chairperson Simison closed public comment.

  The commissioners discussed several areas of concerns throughout the City
  including the area surrounding the Gold Line, street lighting, crosswalks, and
  trails.

  Commissioner Lorge recommended an overlay or diagram to help prioritize the
  project areas.

  Mr. Scherer stated that it is a valid recommendation to City Council to prioritize
  improvements to enhance safety.

  It was moved by Commissioner Lorge and seconded by Commissioner Allison to
  recommend the adoption of the plan to the City Council. Motion carried by a 5-0
  vote.

ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 7:55p.m. The next regular meeting of the Planning
  Commission will be held December 8, 2021 at 6:30 p.m. in the Council
  Chambers, 3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750.
